mechanics.claim: Vel'Koz's abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction to enemies hit, refreshing its duration on basic attacks and subsequent applications.
mechanics.quote: abilities apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Deconstruction'' to enemies hit for 7 seconds, refreshing on {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.

mechanics.claim: The third stack of Deconstruction consumes all stacks to deal a burst of bonus true damage.
mechanics.quote: The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}.

mechanics.claim: A basic attack that misses due to blind does not refresh the stack duration.
mechanics.quote: The stack duration will not be refreshed if the attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}.
